listing.name: Monster Hunter Freedom Unite — FreedomUniteRecomp (PateeerQ)
listing.summary: The retained README reports desktop startup and language selection. ATRAC and MPEG decoders are missing: audio and music are silent, and movies are black. Native Android execution has not been confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe ULES01213 ISO and decrypted EBOOT, with PSP PGF font files from a font folder or PPSSPP installation you are permitted to use. The required version and hash are not confirmed; check upstream before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate and build locally on Windows with CMake and MSVC using scripts/setup.ps1 and scripts/run.ps1. Upstream regenerates overlays as missing ones are found. Android is planned; no Android package or working Android build is confirmed.

warnings: The retained README reports desktop startup and language selection. ATRAC and MPEG decoders are missing: audio and music are silent, and movies are black. Native Android execution has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
